title: Presenting the Bidirectional Smart Visitor Counter — a co...
text:
Presenting the Bidirectional Smart Visitor Counter — a complete IoT solution designed for automated visitor tracking and real-time occupancy monitoring.



The project was designed to address a simple but practical challenge: accurately tracking how many people enter, exit, and are currently inside a facility without relying on manual counting.



The system uses two IR sensors interfaced with a NodeMCU ESP8266 to detect the direction of movement.



By analyzing the sequence in which the sensors are triggered, the system identifies whether a person is entering or exiting and updates the count accordingly.



The NodeMCU processes the sensor data and provides it through a Wi-Fi-enabled REST API using JSON. A custom-built web dashboard consumes this API and presents the information through a clean, interactive interface.



Technology Stack



Hardware: NodeMCU ESP8266 | IR Sensors | Breadboard

Embedded:Arduino IDE | C/C++

Communication:Wi-Fi | HTTP | REST API | JSON

Web:HTML | CSS | JavaScript



What makes this project particularly valuable to me is that it goes beyond a basic hardware prototype. It demonstrates a complete IoT data pipeline



Sensor → ESP8266 → Data Processing → Wi-Fi → REST API → Web Dashboard → Real-Time Visualization



Building this system provided valuable hands-on experience in embedded programming, sensor interfacing, IoT communication, API development, frontend integration, and real-time data visualization.



This project has strengthened my understanding of how hardware and software can work together to build practical, connected solutions.

title: Project Spotlight: TurfTime – Smart Turf Booking System
text:
Project Spotlight: TurfTime – Smart Turf Booking System



Excited to showcase TurfTime, a web-based platform designed to modernize and simplify sports turf bookings.



Many turf facilities still rely on phone calls and WhatsApp messages for reservations, often resulting in scheduling conflicts, missed bookings, and inefficient management. TurfTime addresses these challenges through a centralized and user-friendly digital solution.



Key Features



• Real-time turf availability tracking



• Instant slot booking and secure payment integration



• Dynamic pricing based on peak and non-peak hours



• Dedicated dashboards for players and turf owners



• Automated booking management and schedule updates



Technologies & Skills Applied



• Python



• Django

• Database Management



• User Authentication & Authorization

• Responsive UI/UX Design



This project strengthened my experience in full-stack development, system design, database optimization, and building scalable web applications that solve real-world problems.

title: Machine Learning Learning Journey
text:
Machine Learning Learning Journey



As part of my MCA program, I have been exploring the fundamentals of Machine Learning and gaining hands-on experience by building and evaluating multiple machine learning models using real-world datasets.



Models Implemented



Simple Linear Regression



Developed a model to predict mobile data usage based on daily usage hours and analyzed the relationship between user behavior and data consumption.



Multiple Linear Regression



Built a model to predict smartphone prices using multiple features such as RAM, storage, battery capacity, screen size, processor speed, camera specifications, and brand information.



Polynomial Regression



Implemented a model to capture non-linear relationships and predict sales performance based on advertising expenditure.



K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)



Created a classification model to predict whether a user is likely to purchase a mobile device based on factors such as age, salary, and spending behavior.



Logistic Regression



Developed a classification model to predict laptop purchase decisions using features including price, RAM, storage, processor performance, battery capacity, and other hardware specifications.



Key Learning Outcomes



• Data preprocessing and cleaning



• Feature engineering and data transformation



• Encoding categorical variables



• Regression and classification techniques



• Feature scaling and normalization



• Model training, testing, and evaluation



• Understanding algorithm selection for different business problems



Project Experience



To strengthen my practical understanding, I integrated these algorithms into a mini machine learning project where each model was applied to solve a specific real-world prediction problem. This helped me gain valuable experience in dataset analysis, model selection, performance evaluation, and machine learning workflows.



This journey has strengthened my interest in Machine Learning, Data Science, Python Development, and AI-driven solutions. I look forward to applying these skills to real-world projects and continuously expanding my knowledge in the field.
